mistake_reason: After correctly identifying "Minestrone" as the unique food and mapping it to "Soups and Stews," the orchestrator repeatedly forced re-execution of the uniqueness verification step and changed criteria to exclude dish-level items, then demanded multiple redundant confirmations. This unnecessary repetition (FM-1.3) discarded valid progress and led the team to pivot to a base-ingredient-only lens, culminating in the wrong category ("Vegetables").
